title: Copper-mediated cyclization of thiosemicarbazones leading to 1,3,4-thiadiazoles: Structural elucidation, DFT calculations, in vitro biological evaluation and in silico evaluation studies.
authors: Manakkadan, Vipin; Haribabu, Jebiti; Palakkeezhillam, Vishnunarayanan Namboothiri Vadakkedathu; Rasin, Puthiyavalappil; Vediyappan, Ramesh; Kumar, Vaishnu Suresh; Garg, Mohit; Bhuvanesh, Nattamai; Sreekanth, Anandaram
journal: Spectrochimica acta. Part A, Molecular and biomolecular spectroscopy
one_liner_zh: 该文研究铜介导的缩氨基硫脲环化生成噻二唑，涉及小分子与DNA/蛋白结合及对接，但对象为小分子-核酸/蛋白，非蛋白质-DNA互作体系，且无TF-DNA结合建模，仅边缘相关。
abstract: Cancer's global impact necessitates innovative and less toxic treatments. Thiosemicarbazones (TSCs), adaptable metal chelators, offer such potential. In this study, we have synthesized N (4)-substituted heterocyclic TSCs from syringaldehyde (TSL1, TSL2), and also report the unexpected copper-mediated cyclization of the TSCs to form thiadiazoles (TSL3, TSL4), expanding research avenues. This work includes extensive characterization and studies such as DNA/protein binding, molecular docking, and theoretical analyses to demonstrate the potential of the as-prepared TSCs and thiadiazoles against different cancer cells. The DFT results depict that the thiadiazoles exhibit greater structural stability and reduced reactivity compared to the corresponding TSCs. The docking results suggest superior EGFR inhibition for TSL3 with a binding constant value of - 6.99 Kcal/mol. According to molecular dynamics studies, the TSL3-EGFR complex exhibits a lower average RMSD (1.39 nm) as compared to the TSL1-EGFR complex (3.29 nm) suggesting that both the thiadiazole and thiosemicarbazone examined here can be good inhibitors of EGFR protein, also that TSL3 can inhibit EGFR better than TSL1. ADME analysis indicates drug-likeness and oral availability of the thiadiazole-based drugs. The DNA binding experiment through absorption and emission spectroscopy discovered that TSL3 is more active towards DNA which is quantitatively calculated with a K(b) value of 4.74 x 10(6) M(-1), K(q) value of 4.04 x 10(4) M(-1)and K(app) value of 5 x 10(6) M(-1). Furthermore, the BSA binding studies carried out with fluorescence spectroscopy showed that TSL3 shows better binding capacity (1.64 x 10(5) M(-1)) with BSA protein. All the compounds show significant cytotoxicity against A459-lung, MCF-7-breast, and HepG2-liver cancer cell lines; TSL3 exhibits the best cytotoxicity, albeit less effective than cisplatin. Thiadiazoles demonstrate greater cytotoxicity than the TSCs. Overall, the promise of TSCs and thiadiazoles in cancer research is highlighted by this study. Furthermore, it unveils unexpected copper-mediated cyclization of the TSCs to thiadiazoles.
abstract_zh: 癌症的全球性影响迫切需求创新且毒性更低的治疗方法。缩氨基硫脲（TSCs）作为适应性金属螯合剂，展现出此类潜力。在本研究中，我们从丁香醛合成了N(4)-取代杂环TSCs（TSL1、TSL2），并报告了TSCs意外发生铜介导环化形成噻二唑（TSL3、TSL4）的现象，拓展了研究途径。本研究包括全面的表征及DNA/蛋白质结合、分子对接和理论分析等研究，以展示所制备的TSCs和噻二唑对不同癌细胞的潜在作用。DFT结果表明，与相应的TSCs相比，噻二唑表现出更高的结构稳定性和更低的反应活性。对接结果显示，TSL3对EGFR的抑制作用更优，结合常数值为-6.99 Kcal/mol。根据分子动力学研究，TSL3-EGFR复合物的平均RMSD（1.39 nm）低于TSL1-EGFR复合物（3.29 nm），表明本研究中考察的噻二唑和缩氨基硫脲均可作为EGFR蛋白的良好抑制剂，且TSL3对EGFR的抑制效果优于TSL1。ADME分析表明，基于噻二唑的药物具有类药性和口服可利用性。通过吸收和发射光谱进行的DNA结合实验发现，TSL3对DNA的活性更高，定量计算得出K(b)值为4.74 x 10(6) M(-1)，K(q)值为4.04 x 10(4) M(-1)，K(app)值为5 x 10(6) M(-1)。此外，通过荧光光谱进行的BSA结合研究表明，TSL3与BSA蛋白的结合能力更强（1.64 x 10(5) M(-1)）。所有化合物对A459-肺癌、MCF-7-乳腺癌和HepG2-肝癌细胞系均表现出显著的细胞毒性；TSL3显示出最佳的细胞毒性，尽管效果不如顺铂。噻二唑的细胞毒性高于TSCs。总体而言，本研究凸显了TSCs和噻二唑在癌症研究中的前景。此外，本研究揭示了TSCs向噻二唑的意外铜介导环化反应。
